messages:
From: noreply@redwood.ai
To: claire.huang@medsecure.ai
Date: 2027-05-08T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Thank you for signing up — Private deployment interest

Hi Claire,

Thanks for starting a self-serve trial and indicating interest in a Private/VPC deployment for MedSecure.ai. One of our team members will reach out to arrange a short technical demo and compliance walk-through.

What you can expect next:
- An SDR will propose a 30-minute slot for a technical intake.
- A solutions engineer will share SOC2 excerpts and our private deployment checklist.
- We’ll confirm the right stakeholders to join (security, infra, product).

If you need a fast calendar link to book now: https://calendly.com/redwood-onprem/30min

— Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medsecure.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intro + scheduling: Private/VPC demo for MedSecure.ai

Hi Claire —

Thanks for trying Redwood and flagging private deployment. I’m Jonas on the deals team; I’ll coordinate the intake. Quick questions so Olga (SE) can tailor the run-through:

1) Is the pilot focused on PHI-handling flows or network isolation for model hosting?
2) Who from your security/compliance team should join (name + email)?
3) Preferred time window next week (PST/EST/UTC)?

We typically do a 30–45 minute slot: brief architecture fit, SOC2 excerpt, and next steps for a pilot (evidence list + timelines). Olga will propose times below.

Suggested: Mon/Tue 10–12 PST or Tue/Wed 2–4 PM EST. If easier, pick a time on our Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-onprem/30min

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm a couple of options.

Jonas
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Jonas Weber
Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@medsecure.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T08:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + scheduling: Private/VPC demo for MedSecure.ai

Hi Jonas —

Thanks — quick answers below. Apologies for the short note, wanted to get you the essentials before EOD.

1) Pilot is primarily PHI redaction + inference-on-prem for a small set of clinical workflows (70% PHI).
2) Security lead: Claire Huang (that’s me) and Ops engineer: Tim Reynolds (tim.reynolds@datashield.com).
3) Best windows: Tue/Wed mornings PST (8–11am PST). We’re in California.

Also: can Olga share a short SOC2 excerpt (data retention + access controls) and a checklist of network requirements ahead of the call? Our security team will want to triage.

Thanks — we’d like a 45-minute deep-dive to make sure both security and infra questions are covered.

— Claire
Head of Security, MedSecure.ai
security-ops@medsecure.ai

From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-10T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro + scheduling: Private/VPC demo for MedSecure.ai

Claire —

Great context, thanks. I’ve attached a short SOC2 excerpt focused on data retention and access controls (SOC2-Redwood-Excerpt.pdf) and our Private Deploy Checklist (private-deploy-checklist.xlsx). Attached files are redacted to highlight relevant sections only.

Proposed slots (45 min):
- Tue 2027-05-11 08:30–09:15 PST (11:30–12:15 EST)
- Tue 2027-05-11 10:00–10:45 PST
- Wed 2027-05-12 09:00–09:45 PST

If any of those work I’ll send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda: 1) architecture fit (10m) 2) security controls & SOC2 highlights (15m) 3) pilot timeline & next steps (15–20m).

Attachments:
- SOC2-Redwood-Excerpt.pdf (excerpt, 2 pages)
- private-deploy-checklist.xlsx (stub: network ports, KMS/HSM options, audit log retention)

Thanks — Olga
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
